title: dysoxylum excelsum
intro: Dysoxylum excelsum, commonly known as the Philippine teak, is a plant species that belongs to the family Meliaceae. It has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, offering various health benefits such as anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antifungal activities. The therapeutic actions of Dysoxylum excelsum include its ability to lower blood pressure, reduce fever, and aid in wound healing, attributed to its bioactive constituents like flavonoids, alkaloids, and terpenoids. These constituents contribute to the plant's antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties, making it a valuable resource in traditional medicine.
